summary: The Wheatland Union High School District opposes any FCC proposal to terminate or limit the E‑Rate program, arguing that such cuts would severely damage school and library budgets, compromise reliable internet connectivity, and ultimately harm student learning. The Wheatland Union High School District opposes any reduction or sunset of E‑Rate funding, arguing that such cuts would severely harm students, especially those in low‑income and rural communities, by eliminating essential broadband and network infrastructure and forcing budget cuts to instructional and support services.
